If a mixture of 0.482 mol N2 and 0.933 mol of O2 is placed in a 10 L reaction vessel and allowed to form N2O at a temperature for which Kc= 2.0 × 10–37, determine the composition of equilibrium mixture.

When 0.087 mol of NO and 0.0437 mol of Br2 are mixed in a closed container at constant temperature, 0.0518 mol of NOBr is obtained at equilibrium. Calculate equilibrium amount of NO and Br2 .

What is Kc at this temperature ?
6.11 A sample of HI(g) is placed in flask at a pressure of 0.2 atm. At equilibrium the partial pressure of HI(g) is 0.04 atm. What is Kp for the given equilibrium ?

At this temperature, the equilibrium constant, Kc for the reaction N2 (g) + 3H2 (g) 2NH3 (g) is 1.7 × 102. Is the reaction mixture at equilibrium? If not, what is the direction of the net reaction?

Each exercise is split where a centred reaction equation interrupts it, so every prose block matches one contiguous run of the text layer. Powers of ten are written as the text layer has them (Kc= 6.3 × 1014 for ten-to-the-fourteen in block 1, Kp= 2.0 × 1010/bar in block 11, 1.7 × 102 in block 16); the page prints them as superscripts. In block 5 the text layer reads 'between N2 and O2–' and that is copied as is even though the printed formula is O2 with a trailing dash.
